drivingQuestion: Why did Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai prohibit new grain for the entire sixteenth of Nisan?
outcomeNote: the answer continues into the next unit

segments.he: וְשֶׁיְּהֵא יוֹם הֶנֶף כּוּלּוֹ אָסוּר. מַאי טַעְמָא — מְהֵרָה יִבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ, וְיֹאמְרוּ: אֶשְׁתָּקַד מִי לֹא אָכַלְנוּ בְּהֵאִיר מִזְרָח — עַכְשָׁיו נָמֵי נֵיכוֹל.
segments.en: § The mishna taught: Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai also instituted «that» for «the entire day of waving» the omer offering, eating the grain of the new crop «is prohibited.» The Gemara asks: «What is the reason» for this ordinance? The reasoning is that «soon the Temple will be rebuilt and» people «will say: Last year,» when the Temple was in ruins, «didn’t we eat» from the new crop «as soon as the eastern» horizon «was illuminated» on the morning of the sixteenth of Nisan, as the new crop was permitted immediately? «Now too, let us eat» the new grain at that time.
